scope.name: Product Golden Proof
in_scope: prove the complete live Fashion Design Engine product path from semantic garment controls through visible preview, persistent My Designs, clothing-photo review and approved primitive realization
run deterministic provider-off end-to-end proofs across ordinary and difficult CAS-GOLDEN-1/FGA-06 topology profiles without humanoid fallback or hidden-detail invention
prove full-body, portrait and token presentation continuity together with topology fit, masks, occlusion and exact FGA-03 reusable coverage behavior
prove save, remount/reopen, version, duplicate, collection, export/reviewed-import and photo proposal application preserve garment semantics and provenance
prove local PCA/PAPT realization plus ARI registration can close exact supported primitive demand while unsupported topology/provider paths fail closed
prove authority separation: FGA garment truth, FGA-02 fit, FGA-03 demand, FGA-05 reference review, PCA/PAPT production, ARI registration, no equipment/anatomy/mechanics mutation
produce terminal deterministic FDE product proof and close the Fashion Design Engine program only after exact-head Linux, Windows and deterministic comparison GREEN
out_of_scope: new garment semantics, fit rules, production authority or renderer authority
Oaran fashion houses, designers, eras or cultural style catalogs
Mall, marketplace, commerce, public sharing or creator monetization
equipment ownership/stats, anatomy or mechanics mutation
automatic successor selection beyond terminal FDE completion
